info.name: Zydus FNB Portal API
info.description:
API collection for Zydus FNB Portal.

Module-based routes:
- Profile: `/api/profile/*`
- Canteen: `/api/canteen/*`
- IPD: `/api/ipd/*`

**Note**: Login is handled by `zydus-api`. Paste the JWT from the shared login API into the `jwt_token` collection variable before calling FNB Portal endpoints.
